skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and describe basic concepts related to information and information systems, components, basic functions, and roles in organizations.
Understand and identify the position and function of IT used in information systems.
Understand and classify management information systems from a management and decision-making perspective.
Understand and classify business application information systems.
Understand and explain the development process of information systems in organizations.
Understand and describe issues related to resource management and information system security.
Communicate effectively through written and online communication for professional tasks related to management information systems.
Use software to solve management and business administration problems. Possess systematic thinking and modeling skills in approaching and solving problems.
Possess the ability to work independently or participate in groups related to management information systems.
Demonstrate appropriate attitudes and behaviors related to safety and social ethical standards in the field of management information systems.
